decisions.reason: Promotion to its own page in 2024 suggests the cleaning soap meets aspirations as a complementary care product with low carrying cost, so no problemistic search is triggered.
The maintenance oil stayed only mentioned, but it fits the established floor business and needs little slack to carry, so management keeps it while results remain uncertain.
Getting its own page in 2024 signals results above aspiration for this care product for oiled floors, so it stays in the range.
The moisture-protection underlay is a standard accessory sold alongside parquet; with no sign of shortfall, inertia and complementarity favour keeping it.
The high-density foam underlay overlaps with the other underlay and received no added promotion, which raises the risk of pruning, but its low cost makes keeping it the satisficing choice.
Oak parquet lies close to the firm's core wood business, so even with the weak construction market it is kept rather than dropped.
